summary.text: Formation path true inheritance is the formation path legacy left by Gu Immortal Zhen Yuan Zi. Han Li faces its final test deep under tremor desert.

claims.text: An immortal Gu formation left by Zhen Yuan Zi slowly activates for its fated inheritor.
Formation spirit Immortal Gu greets the fated inheritor and warns that Zhen Yuan Zi meant a Gu Immortal.

A voice from the metallic crane neck lamp says Han Li is qualified to inherit, then identifies itself as formation spirit Immortal Gu created by Zhen Yuan Zi, not Zhen Yuan Zi’s will. It explains that the retreat-when-close design selects either deep formation path wisdom or the choice to turn back. Finding Han Li is only a Gu Master, it warns that he cannot suppress the green claw ghost winged lion under the formation, that he has obtained the true inheritance, and that the Gu formation is about to break apart.
After retrieving Han Li from the green claw ghost winged lion’s stomach, Dancer Hong Yun soul searches him and recognizes Zhen Yuan Zi’s formation path true inheritance.

Using Han Li as a mouthpiece, she pressures the formation spirit until it submits, and she receives several Immortal Gu, many mortal Gu, and Zhen Yuan Zi’s complete formation path true inheritance. Formation spirit Immortal Gu is Zhen Yuan Zi’s unique creation that replicates land spirits and heavenly spirits; it is a one-time consumable that vanishes after birth of a formation spirit able to manipulate the formation when given immortal essence. Thousand Transformations’ will names Zhen Yuan Zi as a Che clan Gu Immortal who left the true inheritance away from his clan after being pushed aside. Among her gains are three Immortal Gu, two of them formation path and rank seven, with the formation spirit counted as half an Immortal Gu.

Because Zhen Yuan Zi understood formation spirit Immortal Gu’s limitations, he created formation flag Gu to keep and redeploy a Gu formation. After the earlier collapse, the formation spirit salvages a portion into a smaller incomplete formation that can still last, and formation flag Immortal Gu is among what remains.

Thousand Transformations’ will offers gains from that formation path expert’s true inheritance, and Fang Yuan exchanges immortal materials for the incomplete immortal Gu formation, which contains rank seven formation flag Immortal Gu.
When Fang Yuan returns against the yellow-cloud formation that holds Dancer Hong Yun, he had earlier pretended to ally with her and traded for Zhen Yuan Zi’s formation path inheritance.
